title: The Washington Post partners with OpenAI on search content
summary: The Washington Post is partnering with with OpenAI to integrate news into ChatGPT, providing users with summaries, quotes, and direct links to original reporting.
body: The Washington Post is partnering with with OpenAI to integrate news into ChatGPT, providing users with summaries, quotes, and direct links to original reporting.
summaryZh: 华盛顿邮报宣布与OpenAI建立合作伙伴关系，将新闻内容集成至ChatGPT中。用户可以通过ChatGPT获取该报社的摘要、引用及原始报道链接，此举标志着大模型在新闻搜索与内容分发领域的进一步落地，对媒体行业与AI搜索的结合具有参考意义。
